definitions.gloss: to use for two or more purposes; to serve double duty; to share between uses
definitions.explanation: To use a single item or space for multiple functions rather than having separate ones for each purpose.

examples.japanese: リビングを{書斎|しょさい}と{兼用|けんよう}する。
examples.english: To use the living room as a study as well.

examples.japanese: この{傘|かさ}は{晴雨|せいう}{兼用|けんよう}だ。
examples.english: This umbrella serves for both sun and rain.

examples.japanese: {家族|かぞく}{全員|ぜんいん}でパソコンを{兼用|けんよう}しているので、{順番待|じゅんばんま}ちになることがある。
examples.english: The whole family shares one computer, so sometimes we have to take turns.

notes:
A する-verb from {兼用|けんよう}, composed of {兼|けん} (to combine, to serve concurrently) + {用|よう} (use). Often used as a noun modifier without する: {兼用|けんよう}の (dual-purpose).

USAGE:
Very common in product descriptions and everyday conversation about shared or multi-purpose items. The noun form {兼用|けんよう} is often used directly: AとBの{兼用|けんよう} (serving as both A and B).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {晴雨|せいう}{兼用|けんよう} — for both sun and rain (umbrellas)
- {男女|だんじょ}{兼用|けんよう} — unisex
- {兼用|けんよう}スペース — shared/multi-purpose space
- AとBを{兼用|けんよう}する — to use something as both A and B

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {共用|きょうよう}する — to share (among people; focus on joint access)
- {併用|へいよう}する — to use together, to use concurrently (two things used simultaneously)
- {流用|りゅうよう}する — to divert, to repurpose (redirecting something from its original use)
